why: a restricted, tap-watcher-deferred mana source (Hydraulic Helper: this mana can't be spent to cast a nonartifact spell, and its controller's Captain America untaps it whenever a creature becomes tapped) funds gorge's sorcery-speed equip: gorge's prefix script taps Helper, floats the restricted U while the untap trigger waits on the stack, passes to resolve it, then offers and pays the equip with that mana (CR 106.6, 601.2, 603.3b); dirac's Taps-deferred script route excludes restricted sources and restrSrcAffords counts a deferred restricted source only for instant-speed plays (and only as a stall), so the equip never reaches an offer
